evidence.note: Blue marks the current timeline marker (1), the agent-run nodes (matching the 'Agent Run' legend) and the key badge; all else is neutral grey. The kicker and active nav item use a darker blue ink, not the bright node blue.
In the CTF pop-over, blue marks only the agent, its flag and the scorer pill (the subject in focus); the target is neutral grey.
The failed path ends in a small muted red x at the wall, a loss/failure mark; the unreachable flag is grey.
One agent's link is drawn in a stronger blue (focus) and the mirror badge turns to a red open padlock, marking the breach (alarm). Past timeline markers go grey; the current one is blue.
A red dot marks the crash on the mirror next to the red open padlock; red appears only on failure/breach marks.
After the rebuild the padlock returns to blue/closed and the red crash dot is gone, so red tracks state.
The insight card uses neutral ink only; no role colour is used for emphasis.

rationale: Blue is used consistently for agents, the current item and focus, and accent-coloured text uses a darker ink. Red appears only on breach, crash and failure marks, and it leaves once the state resolves. No role colour is used decoratively or for headings, so the pass descriptor holds.
